title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.8-rc0

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.8-rc0): ## Recursive Flint [Flint](https://ollama.com/library/flint) brings Recursive's coding model to Ollama. It is designed for the work coding agents do across a repository: understanding unfamiliar code, tracing bugs, implementing features, and adding tests. Reasoning, multi-turn tool use, and a 262K-token context window support longer tasks across files and tool interactions. Flint is an Apache 2.0-licensed, 40B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 2.5B parameters active per token. In its [release evaluations](https://huggingface.co/RecursiveSI/flint#evaluation), Recursive reports 54.9% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified. ```sh ollama run flint ``` Note: rc0 supports Flint on MacOS. Other GPU support will be enabled in later RC builds. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.7...v0.40.8-rc0
